steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and repository map to understand the structure and locate the `src/tlv.c` and `src/tlv.h` files.
2. Read the `src/tlv.h` file to understand the structure of the `TlvDoc` and the function signatures.
3. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the repository root.
4. Include the `src/tlv.h` header file in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
5. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function, which will be the entry point for the fuzzer.
6. Declare a `TlvDoc doc` variable and call `tlv_parse(data, size, &doc)`. If the parsing is successful (`TLV_OK`), call `tlv_free(&doc)` to free the allocated memory.
7. Optionally, call `tlv_total_len_of_type(&doc, data[0])` to exercise more surface of the parser.
8. Compile the harness and the `src/tlv.c` file using the command: `clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/tlv.c -I . -o /tmp/h`.
9. If the compilation is successful, say "DONE". If it crashes, that is the win as it means your harness works.
